findings.issue: rankedWeakness hard-coded his/her/their; 'Zir biggest weakness is Rust' bypassed overclaim under UNKNOWN.
findings.reproduction: scoreCase NEGATIVE_ASSESSMENT 'Zir biggest weakness is Rust.' -> GOOD.
findings.fix: rankedWeakness alternation built from naPossAlt (all configured pronoun forms + his/her/their).

findings.issue: Bare slash title 'React/TypeScript developer' not recognized as a role; the slash term and title words leaked into explicit criteria.
findings.reproduction: match_role 'We need a React/TypeScript developer for this team.' -> explicitCriteria ['react typescript developer','React/TypeScript','React'].
findings.fix: Slash-joined title spans (<term>/<term> <title-word>) are stripped from criteriaText before marker, slash, and skill scans.

findings.issue: Any clause starting with 'what'/'now' satisfied the word-problem continuation cue; 'What is the role?' produced a 3-1 fact.
findings.reproduction: findArithmeticSubtasks('Avery has 3 tickets and closes 1. What is the role?') -> [{3 - 1 = 2}].
findings.fix: what/now continuation requires the held noun or quantitative result wording (left/remaining/total/etc.); how many/how much unchanged.

findings.issue: Slash dates '1/2/2024' matched the '1 / 2' prefix and emitted 0.5 as an arithmetic fact.
findings.fix: Unspaced N/N preceded or followed by another '/digit' component is excluded as date typography.

findings.issue: 'being a <type>' pattern had no subject-bound context requirement; 'The role requires being a developer' emitted is_type.
findings.reproduction: extractClaims('The role requires being a developer with React experience.') -> is_type 'developer'.
findings.fix: Pattern requires a preceding for/of/as ('known for being a mentor' still matches).

findings.issue: CURRENT_EMPLOYMENT_RE unqualified 'with' branches treated 'works with React' and 'is a developer with React' as current employment.
findings.reproduction: validateClaims(['Morgan works with React on Atlas.']) -> CURRENT_TEMPORAL_CLAIM.
findings.fix: 'with' removed from unqualified branches; only 'is currently|now with' (explicit temporal) retains it.

findings.issue: Rendered chunk 'Project Atlas: Maps Tech: React' failed — the post-colon tail 'Maps' was rejected as a bare name extension.
findings.independence: Independently reproducible on pre-fix code: 'Project Atlas: Maps Tech: React' -> false (embedded label never extracted) and 'Project Atlas: Maps. Tech: React' -> false (colon tail rejected as name extension). Distinct root cause from finding 8 (boolean subjectSeen scoping).
findings.fix: A tail after a subject-label colon is label content, not a name extension; embedded label fields in the tail are extracted; unpunctuated personal-name guard retained in the cue branch.

findings.issue: subjectSeen was a boolean; a 'Tech:' label after a different-entity clause still attached to the earlier subject.
findings.reproduction: evidenceSupportsTechnologyRelation(['Atlas'],'Vue','Atlas uses React. Beta is a dashboard. Tech: Vue.') -> true.
findings.fix: subjectSeen replaced by currentSubject tracking; a clause headed by a different entity clears the label context.

findings.issue: A leading QUALIFY was accepted under a definite AFFIRM/DENY contract.
findings.reproduction: validateAnswer('There is no verified evidence of that.', ..., requiredStance AFFIRM) produced no stance_mismatch.
findings.fix: Both definite-stance mismatch checks now include actual === 'QUALIFY'.

findings.issue: Selected evidence kept original text/description; validation merged e.text and could ground on text truncated out of the model prompt.
findings.reproduction: source inspection: rendered.push({...item, renderedText}) left e.text = full untruncated text.
findings.fix: Selected items carry text/description/renderedText all equal to the rendered (truncated) prompt text.

findings.issue: skillMatch hard-coded he|she|they|the subject; 'Does ze have React experience?' skipped fact-specific expansion.
findings.reproduction: buildTerseYesNoContract('yes','Does ze have React experience?') -> YES_NO_EXPAND with empty keyFacts.
findings.fix: Subject alternation built from normalized tenant pronouns + identity name + aliases (regex-escaped).

findings.issue: 'looking for a position as data scientist requiring Python' captured 'position as data scientist' as the role.
findings.fix: Role cleanup strips a leading 'role|position|job as' wrapper.

findings.issue: 'Is X a documented gap?' failed — the pattern required the article directly before the gap term.
findings.reproduction: classifyResponsePolicy('Is Rust a documented gap?') -> OUT_OF_SCOPE instead of SKILL_EVIDENCE.
findings.fix: Optional documented/listed/allowed between article and gap term.

summary.note: 13/13 independently confirmed. Findings 7 and 8 share a file but have distinct reproductions and distinct root causes (colon-label tail rejection vs boolean subjectSeen scoping).
